data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that initializes Firebase and allows multiple Firebase app connections.
data.what_it_does: Provides the core Firebase functionality for Flutter apps, enabling initialization of Firebase services and support for multiple Firebase apps within a single project. It bridges Flutter with the native Firebase SDKs on Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
use_when: You need to use any Firebase service (auth, analytics, firestore, etc.) in a Flutter app.
You want to support multiple Firebase projects in the same app.
avoid_when: You are building a non-Firebase backend or only need a single Firebase project and prefer a lighter setup.
strengths: Stable, actively maintained by Firebase team.
Supports all major platforms out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires native platform setup (e.g., adding GoogleService-Info.plist or google-services.json).
May add unnecessary overhead if only a single Firebase service is used.
data.setup_notes: Add google-services.json (Android) or GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS/macOS) to the project, configure Gradle/Podfile, and call Firebase.initializeApp() in main().
